mapper.select: SELECT a.shop_id, b.shop_name, b.shop_self_support FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_user_cart a LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base b ON a.shop_id = b.supplier_shop_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} and a.cart_status = 0 group by a.shop_id order by a.insert_cart_time desc

SELECT o.shop_name, o.goods_name, o.goods_image, o.goods_num, o.goods_price, o.goods_stock, o.goods_spec_chinese_value, o.insert_cart_time, u.user_mobile, u.user_name FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_user_cart o LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.cart_status = 0
and u.user_name like concat('%',#{param.userName},'%')
and u.user_mobile like concat('%',#{param.userMobile},'%')
SELECT sum(goods_num) FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_user_cart WHERE cart_status = 0 and user_id = #{userId} and common_id = #{commonId}
select shop_gate_goods_stock from ${database.prefix.business}hou_shop_gate_goods_base where shop_gate_id = #{shopGateId} and goods_id = #{goodsId}
